_comment: Who the generated pages are FROM. Every page is a pitch from this sender to a target company. Edit this file to point the tool at your own company — nothing else in src/ carries brand identity.
name: Northstar Analytics
metaDescription: {sender} — see where {company}'s pipeline actually comes from, across every channel.
footerLine: See where your pipeline actually comes from — across every channel, in one model.
_accentComment: The sender's own accent — the 'sender voice' on agent cards and the recommendation band. Distinct from the TARGET's brand color, which drives the primary accent and comes from each page spec's brandColor.
_calComment: Default booking link for the `booking` closer. A page spec's `cal` field overrides this; CAL_LINK in .env overrides both.
